svg.title: Darb, my personal project
svg.desc: Darb is my own thing, not something I built for a company. The name means path in Arabic. Lama, my co-founder, and I started it from scratch, and I built the whole thing myself, from the database to the UI. People search it for local businesses, friends add the places missing from their towns, and the businesses run their own pages on it. Right now it covers the north of Israel. I want it in every town in the country, and then beyond.
